scenes.text: Hello little friends! I'm Blu Pup, and today we're going to explore something really special called emotional regulation. It's all about learning how to feel calm and happy, even when things get a little wobbly. Are you ready to join me on this exciting adventure? We'll play games and learn together about feelings and how to manage them. Let's start this wonderful journey with a big smile!

Emotional regulation is a big word, isn't it? But it's really just about how we handle our feelings, like when we feel super happy or a little grumpy. Have you ever felt like a volcano ready to explode when you're upset? That's when emotional regulation can help us cool down. It’s like having a magic tool to help us feel better. Imagine having a special button that can make you feel calm again. Isn't that amazing?

Now, let's learn a fun way to use our magic tool when we feel upset. It's called taking deep breaths. First, sit comfortably and place your hands on your tummy. Let's breathe in slowly like we're smelling a yummy flower. Hold it, and now breathe out like you're blowing out a candle. Let's try it together three times. Deep breaths can help you feel calm and relaxed. Doesn't that feel nice?

Great job, everyone! You're doing wonderfully with your calming breaths. Remember, you can use these breaths anytime you feel a little upset. Maybe when a toy doesn't work or you can't find your favorite book. Just take a deep breath and feel your magic calm button working. You can do it!

Now, let's talk about another way to help with feelings. Have you ever tried counting to five when you're upset? It's like a little game to distract your mind. Imagine you're counting colorful butterflies flying by. One, two, three, four, five. By the time you finish, you might feel a bit calmer. Counting gives your brain a chance to relax and think clearly.

Let's practice counting together now. Imagine you’re in a beautiful garden with butterflies all around. Count each one as it flutters past. One, two, three, four, five. Wasn't that fun? Counting is a simple way to help manage big feelings. Next time you're upset, try counting and see how it helps you feel better.

You’re doing an amazing job learning these new skills! Remember, practice makes perfect. The more you use your breathing and counting, the easier it will become. You have all the power inside you to feel calm and happy. Keep practicing, and soon you'll be a pro at handling your feelings. You can achieve anything!

Let's imagine a time when you might need to use these skills. What if you're playing with a friend and they take your favorite toy? That might make you feel upset, right? This is a perfect time to use your calm button. Take a deep breath, count to five, and then think about how to solve the problem. Talking to your friend and sharing your feelings can also help. It’s all about working together.

Have you ever had a time when you felt really upset or sad? What did you do to feel better? Let's think about it together. Maybe you took a deep breath or counted to five, just like we practiced. It's okay to have big feelings, and it's great to have ways to help manage them. Can you think of other times you might use your calm button?

Remember when we talked about butterflies? Sometimes, imagining a happy place can also help us feel better. Close your eyes and picture a place where you feel safe and happy. Maybe it's a sunny beach or a cozy blanket fort. Whenever you feel upset, you can visit this happy place in your mind. It’s like a mini-vacation that helps you feel calm and joyful.

Let's create our happy place together. Close your eyes and think about what makes you smile. Is it a bright rainbow or a field of flowers? Use your imagination to build this place in your mind. Whenever you need to feel calm, just close your eyes and go there. Your happy place is always with you, ready to help you feel better.

You’ve learned so much about handling your feelings today! Remember, you have your magic calm button, your counting game, and a special happy place. You’re ready to face any big feelings that come your way. Keep practicing these skills every day, and soon you’ll be a feelings expert. You're doing a fantastic job, and I’m so proud of you!

Let’s remember that everyone feels big emotions sometimes, and that's perfectly okay. The important thing is knowing how to handle them. With practice, you can use your new skills to stay calm and happy. You can even teach your family and friends these tricks. Imagine everyone using their calm buttons together. What a peaceful world that would be!

Do you think you’ll try these calming tricks next time you feel upset? I hope you do! Which one do you like best: the deep breaths, counting to five, or visiting your happy place? They’re all fun and helpful in their own way. Remember, practice makes perfect, and you’re already doing great. Can you think of other ways to feel calm when you're upset?

Well, little friends, it's time to say goodbye. We’ve had such a fun time learning about emotional regulation together. Remember, you have all the tools you need to feel calm and happy. Keep practicing, and soon you'll be a master of your feelings. Thank you for joining me today. Until next time, keep smiling and using your magic calm button. Goodbye, and have a wonderful day!
